info.title: Parksical API contract
info.description: Mixed implemented/design contract. S-03 development authentication, S-04 capability/close metadata ingestion and S-05 ADMIN+WEB synthetic parking lot/revision management are implemented. Public lot search/detail and difficulty remain design. Login D-01, driving data D-02 and real sources D-03 remain pending; no production deployment or actual SDK validation is claimed.

developmentKey.name: X-Development-Key
developmentKey.description: Configured development-only shared key; disabled in production.

parkingSpaces.description: Omitted = not mapped; [] = mapped but none. COMPLETE requires explicit arrays and at least one parking space. Whole JSON request remains limited to 64KiB.

pillars.description: Omitted = not mapped; [] = mapped but none. COMPLETE requires explicit arrays and at least one parking space. Whole JSON request remains limited to 64KiB.

driveAisles.description: Explicit free-space drive corridors. COMPLETE requires connected aisles and approach geometry for every space.

AdminLotSnapshot.description: Versioned structure with individual bays, protected pillar islands, connected drive aisles and unobstructed approach rectangles. Checks are planar geometric checks, not car-specific swept-path, building-code or ramp design approval.

ParkingSpace.description: Structural space, not sensed occupancy. Heading is counterclockwise from local +x toward vehicle front; units degrees. Dimensions are authored synthetic values, not legal/safety certification.

SpaceApproach.description: Clear rectangular approach from the specified bay edge, not a collision-free vehicle trajectory. Depth must be at least the referenced aisle width. Entire area must avoid other bays/pillar islands, enter the same-floor/zone aisle and remain inside the zone.
